question: Which of the following teams won the 12th edition of the Ice Hockey Association of India’s (IHAI) National Ice Hockey Championship for Men in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)** won the 12th edition of the Ice Hockey Association of India's (IHAI) National Ice Hockey Championship for Men in 2023.
 
• The championship witnessed participation from various teams across the country.</li
